contexts: paper nomogram at the main site
computer-assisted dosing tool at two satellites since October 2025
home INR results entered by clerical staff
reading: The comparison the director wants runs across sites, so the dosing approach is tangled with site: the satellites see younger patients with fewer interacting medicines, and home testing adds entry delays that may differ by site. Time in therapeutic range can only be calculated where INR records are complete, which is exactly what is unknown. With an empty recorded search and no inspected evidence, the local records are the only source, and their fitness for purpose decides which design is possible.
